removal.dots: debuff subtype; cleanse removes unless flagged. (Doom is REMOVED from the game -- see no_instant_death.)
removal.control: cleansable unless flagged; Enrage family is uncleansable

_rules.stacking: only stacks=true effects stack (DoTs: Poison/Bleed/Burn/Curse + a few flagged). Non-stacking uses REFRESH-IF-STRONGER: a stronger application overwrites; weaker is ignored; equal refreshes duration.
_rules.undispellable: any effect may set dispellable=false (buffs) / cleansable=false (debuffs) — used for Gold permanence, Dark's uncleansable pressure, and the Enrage family.
_rules.team_wide_rule: 'team-wide' is NOT a separate effect — it's a target/duration modifier the ABILITY sets. Standard effects (ATK Up, Regen, POT Up, etc.) can be applied single-target OR team-wide; team versions are balanced by shorter duration or by being gated to rarer units. Do not author 'team_x' as its own entry.
_rules.control_ladder: Action-denial ladder — each blocks exactly ONE action type: Disarm=no basics, Silence=no skills, Sealed=no ults. Stun=full lockout (all three) + still takes damage. Freeze=lose turn but immune to direct damage (DoTs tick), 1 turn then breaks. Sleep=lose turns + self-heal 20%/turn, breaks on damage.
_rules.enrage_system: Enrage (Berserk/Frenzy/Overload) is UNCLEANSABLE and TRIGGER-BOUND (hp_threshold/phase/turn_count/on_effect:<id>/manual) — almost never a cast skill. Enemy-focused; rarely a (double-edged) player buff. Pair with 'prevent_death_team' (Last Line) for the signature un-killable-but-deadly survival window.
_rules.trigger_field: effects with a 'trigger' key are applied by a CONDITION, not by casting. The combat engine watches for the trigger and applies the effect when it fires.
_rules.value_note: 'X%' values are set per-ability (the skill defines the magnitude); this glossary defines the EFFECT, the kit defines the NUMBER.
_rules.ability_fields: Conditional damage, hit-shape, and pen live on the ABILITY, not in effects[]: 'hits' (int, multi-hit), 'ignore_def' (0..1 fraction of DEF ignored), 'bonus_vs' ({condition, amount} conditional damage/crit — the set-up->exploit layer), 'triggers' ([{effect,on}] condition-applied effects using the trigger_field rule). effects[] holds ONLY valid glossary status ids.
_rules.no_instant_death: Doom (death-on-timer) is REMOVED. Timed pressure uses debuff_bomb: countdown -> debuff payload on expiry, never a guaranteed kill.
_rules.magnitude_schema: Effects on abilities are objects: {id, mag(%/value), dur(turns), chance(0-1 base apply), stacks}. Magnitude TYPE by effect: PERCENT_STAT (mag=% stat delta), PERCENT_HP (mag=% max HP), DOT (mag=% target HP/tick), MOMENTUM (mag=% gauge), DURATION_ONLY (value from dur+chance), SPECIAL (bespoke: execute=threshold%, etc). atk_up_major/def_break_major/regen_major FOLDED into base id with high mag.

effects.name: Attack Up
effects.desc: +X% ATK.

effects.name: Defense Up
effects.desc: +X% DEF.

effects.name: Speed Up
effects.desc: +X% SPD (faster Momentum gain).

effects.name: Crit Rate Up
effects.desc: +X% Crit Rate.

effects.name: Crit Damage Up
effects.desc: +X% Crit Damage.

effects.name: Potency Up
effects.desc: +X% Potency (debuffs land harder).

effects.name: Resolve Up
effects.desc: +X% Resolve (resist incoming debuffs).

effects.name: Regeneration
effects.desc: Heal X% max HP at end of each turn.

effects.name: Shield
effects.desc: Absorbs up to X damage, then breaks.

effects.name: Aegis (Shield)
effects.desc: A shield that cannot be bypassed by ignore-DEF/pierce.

effects.name: Damage Reduction
effects.desc: Takes X% less damage from all sources.

effects.name: Unbending (Damage Reduction)
effects.desc: Damage reduction that cannot itself be reduced/ignored.

effects.name: Reflect
effects.desc: Returns X% of damage taken to the attacker.

effects.name: Counter Stance
effects.desc: Counterattacks the next enemy who strikes this unit.

effects.name: Bloodthirst
effects.desc: This unit's damage heals it for X% (temporary).

effects.name: Debuff Immunity
effects.desc: Cannot receive new debuffs while active.

effects.name: Unstoppable
effects.desc: Immune to control (Stun/Freeze/Silence/Disarm/Sealed/Taunt/push).

effects.name: Undying
effects.desc: Cannot drop below 1 HP while active (survives lethal). Dispellable — enemies can strip it for counterplay.

effects.name: True Aim
effects.desc: This unit's attacks cannot miss while active.

effects.name: Perfect Focus
effects.desc: This unit's next X hits are guaranteed crits.

effects.name: Evasion Up
effects.desc: +X% chance to dodge incoming attacks.

effects.name: Provoke (self)
effects.desc: Forces enemies to target this unit.

effects.name: Veil
effects.desc: Cannot be targeted by single-target attacks (until it acts / X turns).

effects.name: Rooted
effects.desc: Immune to enemy Momentum push/pull.

effects.name: Sovereign Ward
effects.desc: This unit's buffs cannot be stripped by enemies.

effects.name: Coronation Aura
effects.desc: +X% to all core stats; unremovable while active.

effects.name: Decree
effects.desc: Marks the attached stat buff as non-expiring (permanent until dispelled).

effects.name: Attack Down
effects.desc: -X% ATK.

effects.name: Defense Break
effects.desc: -X% DEF.

effects.name: Slow
effects.desc: -X% SPD (slower Momentum gain).

effects.name: Crit Rate Down
effects.desc: -X% Crit Rate.

effects.name: Potency Down
effects.desc: -X% Potency (their debuffs fail more).

effects.name: Resolve Down
effects.desc: -X% Resolve (easier to debuff).

effects.name: Brand
effects.desc: Target takes +X% damage from ALL sources.

effects.name: Anti-Heal
effects.desc: Healing received reduced by X% (up to 100%).

effects.name: Blind
effects.desc: This unit's attacks have an X% chance to miss.

effects.name: Heal Block
effects.desc: Cannot be healed at all while active.

effects.name: Null
effects.desc: Cannot receive new buffs while active.

effects.name: Exposed
effects.desc: Takes +X% damage from a marked source/team.

effects.name: Shatterproof
effects.desc: Cannot gain new shields while active.

effects.name: Marked
effects.desc: Team deals +X% to this target; enables 'exploit' effects.

effects.name: Dampened
effects.desc: Gains Momentum X% slower.

effects.name: Sundered Affinity
effects.desc: Loses affinity advantage / takes affinity disadvantage.

effects.name: Poison
effects.desc: Deals X% of target max HP as damage each turn. Stacks.

effects.name: Bleed
effects.desc: Deals flat X damage each turn, scales w/ caster ATK. Stacks.

effects.name: Burn
effects.desc: Deals X damage each turn; bonus vs low-DEF. Stacks. NOTE: damage-calc method flagged for a future tweak.

effects.name: Curse
effects.desc: Damage each turn that INCREASES the longer it remains. Stacks.

effects.name: Stun
effects.desc: FULL LOCKOUT: skips the turn entirely AND still takes damage normally. The offensive control — lock them and burst them.

effects.name: Freeze
effects.desc: Loses its turn when Momentum fills, BUT is immune to DIRECT damage while frozen (DoTs still tick). Costs ONE turn, then breaks. Defensive/stall control — you can't burst a frozen enemy, so freezing a low-HP target actually protects it.

effects.name: Silence
effects.desc: Cannot use SKILLS (basic attacks & ults still usable).

effects.name: Disarm
effects.desc: Cannot use BASIC ATTACKS (skills & ults still usable). Value spikes when the enemy's skills/ults are on cooldown — then they have nothing to do and lose the turn.

effects.name: Taunt
effects.desc: Forced to target the taunting unit.

effects.name: Mass Taunt
effects.desc: All affected enemies forced to target the caster.

effects.name: Sleep
effects.desc: Skips turns AND heals 20% max HP per turn; breaks on damage taken. Double-edged risk control — you gift HP for tempo, and the enemy may even want to keep it.

effects.name: Sealed
effects.desc: Cannot use ULTS (basic attacks & skills still usable). Third rung of the action-denial ladder.

effects.name: Heal
effects.desc: Restore X% of target max HP (or flat).

effects.name: Team Heal
effects.desc: Heal all allies.

effects.name: Revive
effects.desc: Bring a fallen ally back at X% HP.

effects.name: Cleanse
effects.desc: Remove X debuffs from a target (skips uncleansable).

effects.name: Mass Cleanse
effects.desc: Remove all cleansable debuffs from the team.

effects.name: Strip
effects.desc: Remove X buffs from ONE enemy (skips undispellable).

effects.name: Strip (Multi)
effects.desc: Remove X buffs from MULTIPLE enemies (not a full wipe — X per target, skips undispellable).

effects.name: Momentum Push
effects.desc: Reduce target's Momentum gauge by X%.

effects.name: Momentum Pull
effects.desc: Increase an ally's Momentum gauge by X%.

effects.name: Momentum Steal
effects.desc: Take X% Momentum from an enemy, give to an ally.

effects.name: Extra Action
effects.desc: Target immediately gains an extra turn.

effects.name: Hasten
effects.desc: Reduce an ally's cooldowns by X turns.

effects.name: Refund
effects.desc: Refund this unit's cooldown (often on kill).

effects.name: Shrug Off
effects.desc: This unit removes debuffs from itself.

effects.name: Detonate
effects.desc: Consume all DoT stacks on a target for burst damage.

effects.name: Execute
effects.desc: Instantly kill a target below X% HP.

effects.name: Setback
effects.desc: Push target to the back of the turn order.

effects.name: Blood Price
effects.desc: Caster spends X% HP to power an effect.

effects.name: Blood Bond
effects.desc: Allies share one HP pool for the duration (damage spread).

effects.name: Ramp
effects.desc: A stat/effect that grows each turn or each use (per-unit defined).

effects.name: Last Stand
effects.desc: Effect strengthens the lower the unit's own HP.

effects.name: Retribution
effects.desc: Stored damage taken converts into output on a trigger.

effects.name: Wild Magic
effects.desc: Outcome is randomized within a defined band (the gamble).

effects.name: Charge
effects.desc: Plants a charge that detonates on a later turn.

effects.name: Threat
effects.desc: Alters how much aggro this unit generates (up or down).

effects.name: Martyr
effects.desc: Pulls debuffs off allies onto this unit; may gain from holding them.

effects.name: Last Line
effects.desc: Team cannot drop below 1 HP for the duration.

effects.name: Immutable
effects.desc: Caps damage taken per hit at X% of max HP (anti-burst).

effects.name: Unresistable
effects.desc: Flags an effect to ignore the Potency/Resolve contest (always lands).

effects.name: Crimson Bond
effects.desc: All damage this unit deals also heals the team X%. (Was a buff; promoted to signature-tier special.)

effects.name: Wasting
effects.desc: Target loses X% max HP each turn AND -healing received. (Special debuff — a %maxHP DoT fused with sustain-denial.)

effects.name: Shared Agony
effects.desc: While active on an ally, enemies that damage them take reflected curse damage. (Special debuff/reflect hybrid.)

effects.name: DoT-Spread
effects.desc: Copy a target's DoTs (Poison/Bleed/Burn/Curse) to all enemies.

effects.name: Debuff-Spread
effects.desc: Copy ANY of a target's debuffs (incl. control & stat-downs) to all enemies. Rarer & stronger than DoT-Spread.

effects.name: Berserk (Enrage)
effects.desc: +big ATK, but takes more damage. Glass-cannon rage — you CAN race it down, but every hit it lands is brutal.

effects.name: Frenzy (Enrage)
effects.desc: Extra actions / Momentum surge — the enemy acts far more often. The scramble is TEMPO: it takes several turns to your one.

effects.name: Overload (Enrage)
effects.desc: Ultimates come off cooldown / can be re-used repeatedly. The scramble is BURST: big hits keep landing.

effects.name: DoT Amplify
effects.desc: Target takes +X% damage from all damage-over-time effects (Poison/Bleed/Burn/Curse). Set per-ability.

effects.name: Debuff Bomb
effects.desc: A timed marker that ticks down over N turns (visible counter). On expiry it does NOT kill — it detonates, applying a payload of debuffs defined by the ability. Removing the marker before detonation (cleanse, if cleansable) defuses it. The bomb-planter's kit sets the countdown and payload.
